{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness plugin: read_document tool — Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF as Markdown for the model","id":"gh:1335010504","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-document","slug":"jiaoqsh/dsh-document","topics":["deepseek-harness","docx","dsh-plugin","markdown","pdf"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness plugin: read_document tool — Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV,"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" and PDF as Markdown for the model"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-document"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle (`@jiaoqsh/dsh-document`) that gives the model a `read_document` to"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ol: Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF files are converted to line-numbe"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"red Markdown the model can page through with `offset`/`limit`."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Conversion runs locally: office formats through `@firecrawl/anydoc` (Rust core, Node bindings) and P"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"DFs through `@firecrawl/pdf-inspector` (WASM build, run in a worker thread) — no API key, no network"},{"id":"p4s3","text":", no external binaries; both MIT. PDFs get page selection, `` markers, and page facts: total pages, "},{"id":"p4s4","text":"text-based / scanned / mixed, and which pages have no extractable text. Files are read through the h"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"arness `ctx.fs` seam, so whatever filesystem provider and sandbox policy a deployment mounts applies"},{"id":"p4s6","text":".fs` seam, so whatever filesystem provider and sandbox policy a deployment mounts applies unchanged."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Into an existing profile (`web`, `headless`, or your own), from npm:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The npm package ships built code, so nothing runs at install time. Releases are published from this "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"repository's `release.yml` through npm trusted publishing and carry provenance attestations."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### From GitHub instead"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"A git install fetches sources, so pnpm ≥ 10 refuses to run the package's `prepare` (a `tsdown` trans"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"pile of `src/`) until you allow it: the first `add` fails and prints the exact key to copy into the "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/pnpm-workspace.yaml`). The key names the"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" resolved tarball, so a bare package name does not match:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Re-run the `add`. Allowing the build means executing this package's code on your machine at install "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"time; pin a commit so a later push cannot change what runs."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"`dsh plugin` prints "missing peer" warnings for the `@deepseek-ai/*` packages: expected. The dsh ins"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"tallation supplies them at runtime; profiles deliberately do not install peers."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Verify, then boot:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove @jiaoqsh/dsh-document`."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### From a source checkout of the harness"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"where the overlay inserts the built entry by absolute path:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The bundle's layer inserts one row, `document-tools`, with schema defaults. Override it by id in you"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"r profile's `cordis.patch.yml`; a patch replaces the whole `config`, so restate every key you need:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Key | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| `maxInputBytes` | 52428800 (50 MiB) | Inclusive byte cap on the source file. Enforced by the files"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ystem provider before any bytes are buffered; larger files are refused. |
| `readLimit` | 2000 | Def"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"ault and maximum number of Markdown lines returned by one call. |
| `maxLineLength` | 2000 | Maximum"},{"id":"p26s4","text":" characters per returned line; overflow is cut with `… [line truncated]`. |
| `maxOutputBytes` | 512"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"00 (50 KiB) | Maximum bytes of line text returned by one call; the window stops early and the footer"},{"id":"p26s6","text":" says how to continue. |
| `pdfMaxPages` | 100 | Maximum distinct pages one `pages` selection may na"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"me. |
| `pdfProfile` | `fidelity` | PDF Markdown profile: `fidelity` keeps source structure, `compac"},{"id":"p26s8","text":"t` spends fewer tokens. |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Every numeric value must be a positive integer and `pdfProfile` one of the two names; anything else "},{"id":"p27s2","text":"fails the plugin load with a message naming the key."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## The tool"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"`read_document(file_path, offset?, limit?, pages?)`"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- `file_path` — resolved by the filesystem backend; relative paths resolve against the calling sessi"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"on's workspace.
- `offset` — 1-based first line of the converted Markdown (default 1).
- `limit` — l"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"ines to return (default and maximum `readLimit`).
- `pages` — PDF only: 1-based pages to convert, as"},{"id":"p30s4","text":" numbers and ranges like `"1-3,7"` (at most `pdfMaxPages`). Default: every page. Naming a page beyon"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"d the last one is an error that states the page count."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Supported extensions: `.pdf`, `.doc`, `.docm`, `.docx`, `.ppt`, `.pps`, `.pot`, `.pptx`, `.pptm`, `."},{"id":"p31s2","text":"ppsx`, `.ppsm`, `.xls`, `.xlsx`, `.xlsm`, `.xlsb`, `.odt`, `.ods`, `.odp`, `.rtf`, `.epub`, `.csv`. "},{"id":"p31s3","text":"The format comes from the extension, never from content sniffing (CSV has no signature)."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Canonical value (what Code Mode receives):"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Model-facing text (a PDF, pages 2 and 4 of 5):"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"A mixed PDF adds `<warning>Pages 3, 7-8 contain no extractable text (scanned or image content); thei"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"r content is missing below and would need OCR.</warning>` before `<content>`. Non-PDF formats omit t"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"sing below and would need OCR.</warning>` before `<content>`. Non-PDF formats omit the `<pdf>` line."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"Failures are tool errors in model terms: unsupported extension (pointing at `read` for plain text), "},{"id":"p37s2","text":"`pages` on a non-PDF, a malformed `pages` value, not found, not a regular file, over `maxInputBytes`"},{"id":"p37s3","text":", encrypted, damaged or incomplete, engine resource limit, a page beyond the last page, cancellation"},{"id":"p37s4","text":", or no extractable text (a scanned or image-only PDF says so and that OCR is needed; this tool perf"},{"id":"p37s5","text":"ctable text (a scanned or image-only PDF says so and that OCR is needed; this tool performs no OCR)."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"#### What the model sees"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"One fixed sentence, order 100 beside the shipped `tool:read` guidance:"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"## Known Limitations and Deferred Work"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"- **No OCR** — pages without a text layer are reported (`pagesNeedingOcr`, the `<warning>` line) but"},{"id":"p42s2","text":" not read; a fully scanned or image-only PDF is an error naming the cause.
- **PDF conversion runs i"},{"id":"p42s3","text":"n a fresh worker thread per call** — cancellation terminates it, and the harness event loop stays fr"},{"id":"p42s4","text":"ee, at the cost of ~50 ms of WASM start-up per call. Office-format conversion (anydoc) runs on the l"},{"id":"p42s5","text":"ibuv thread pool and cannot be cancelled once started; `maxInputBytes` is its bound.
- **Layout-heav"},{"id":"p42s6","text":"y PDFs may collapse paragraphs into long lines** (then cut by `maxLineLength`); `pdfProfile: compact"},{"id":"p42s7","text":"` trades structure for tokens.
- **Engines are fixed** — the `DocumentConverter` interface and `rout"},{"id":"p42s8","text":"eConverters` in `src/converter.ts` are the seam for a hosted or OCR-capable engine; none is wired to"},{"id":"p42s9","text":"day.
- **The pdf-inspector native binary is not used** — its npm build ships no `darwin-x64` binary,"},{"id":"p42s10","text":" so the WASM build runs everywhere for one code path."}],"truncated":true}
